name: None
summary: The agent keeps no state between sessions: each conversation starts from the system prompt and whatever the user pastes in. LLM APIs are stateless by default, so this is the baseline every other memory option builds on.
how: Start each session with only the system prompt and project files
Let the user restate context when it matters
Discard the transcript when the session ends
facts: Raw LLM API calls, one-off chats, CI and cron jobs
Predictable and private, but nothing learned carries over
watchOut: Users repeat preferences and context every time
Long projects lose decisions between sessions
